text:
{ "entries": [
  {
    "name_han": "太上三元赐福赦罪解厄消灾延生保命妙经",
    "logic_thesis": "Fortune, disaster, lifespan, and karmic debt are not fixed fate-blocks but administratively reversible under Heaven’s tripartite tribunal (Heaven–Earth–Water). The text proves that sincere repentance plus ritual alignment with the Three Officers can rewrite the ledger of destiny, making “extension of life” a juridical-moral process rather than mere petition.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: All beings are under continuous audit by the Three Officials who record merit and demerit.
2) Premise: Calamity and short life are effects of unresolved guilt recorded in those ledgers.
3) Inference: If the ledger is the cause, then pardon and merit-transfer can alter the effect.
4) Inference: Ritual confession, vow, and recitation are the lawful channels that petition and update the ledger.
5) Conclusion: Therefore disaster-relief and life-extension are achieved by moral-juridical correction under the Sanyuan system, not by coercion of the cosmos.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Map BaZi “illness/disaster stars” as ledger-symptoms: treat them as invitations to repent-and-correct, not as irreversible doom.
2) Use Three Officials timing (15th of 1st/7th/10th lunar months; or upper/middle/lower yuan cycles) to schedule confession, charity, and vow renewal.
3) Pair Day Master weakness or clash years with concrete merit acts (releasing life, debt repayment, apology) before purely technical remedies.
4) In cultivation, keep a nightly “merit–fault ledger” mirroring Sanyuan audit logic.
5) When reading “延生保命,” prioritize purifying intent and social harm-repair over amulet-only solutions.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike pure talismanic disaster-dispelling texts that treat power as external force, this scripture centers juridical pardon and moral accounting. Unlike pure internal-alchemy longevity texts, it locates life-extension in celestial bureaucracy and ethical correction. Its distinct logic is: destiny is a court record that can be amended."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "重阳立教十五论",
    "logic_thesis": "True Quanzhen cultivation is not escape into technique but a graduated reorganization of life—dwelling, companions, study, work, sleep, and death—so that the Dao becomes the form of ordinary conduct. The text proves that without correct outer order (community, scripture, labor, stillness), inner alchemy collapses into self-deception.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: The mind scatters when environment, company, and daily rhythm are disordered.
2) Premise: Dao is realized through continuous practice, not isolated peak experiences.
3) Inference: Therefore lodging, travel, study, and work must be redesigned as supports of one-pointedness.
4) Inference: Scripture reading, seated meditation, and “matching natures” (hehe) train both insight and social virtue.
5) Inference: Detachment from wealth and fame removes the fuel of false seeking.
6) Conclusion: The fifteen essays form a single causal ladder: outer discipline → stable mind → genuine inner work → liberation at death.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Audit lifestyle before chart techniques: sleep, companions, speech, and livelihood as primary “stem–branch” of practice.
2) Use BaZi strong Fire/Wood restlessness as signal to emphasize sitting, quiet study, and limited travel per Chongyang’s rules.
3) Treat “matching natures” as partner/teacher selection criterion in cultivation communities.
4) Convert reading classics into daily short sessions rather than rare binge study.
5) At major luck-cycle transitions, re-apply the fifteen topics as a life-redesign checklist.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike Southern Song technical neidan manuals that begin with medicine and fire phases, Chongyang starts from communal ethics and living arrangements. Unlike pure monastic codes, it still aims at interior realization. Its difference is pedagogical: form of life first, secret method second."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "灵宝领教济度金书",
    "logic_thesis": "Salvation of the dead and living is an engineered liturgy: offices, documents, visualizations, and graded ranks transmit celestial authority into measurable deliverance. The work proves that “degree and ferrying” (jidù) is not vague compassion but a complete ritual technology of cosmic administration.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Souls suffer because they lack light, name-clearance, and pathway through the bureaucratic cosmos.
2) Premise: Lingbao liturgy inherits primordial writs that can reopen those pathways.
3) Inference: Correct rank, vestment, document, and mudra align the priest as a lawful officer of Heaven.
4) Inference: Sequential rites (purification, summoning, confession, transformation, rebirth) process the soul like a court case and medical cure combined.
5) Conclusion: Mass deliverance is possible when personal virtue + institutional rite + celestial text coincide.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Read ancestral hardship in BaZi (void, tomb, extreme Water/Metal grief) as possible unresolved lineage debt requiring jidù logic, not only personal luck-fix.
2) Before major destiny shifts, perform or sponsor structured requiem/confession rites rather than ad-hoc prayer.
3) Train visualization of light-body and document-sending as mind-stability practice even without full liturgy.
4) Use the text’s rank-and-office model to understand “authority” in talisman work: no office, no effect.
5) Align charity and public good works as the ethical warrant that makes ritual petitions valid.",
    "logic_compare": "Compared with short Lingbao scriptures of praise and promise, this is an operational encyclopedia of how salvation is done. Compared with Quanzhen’s interior emphasis, it externalizes compassion into institutional rite. Its signature is liturgical engineering of universal deliverance."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "净明忠孝全书",
    "logic_thesis": "Celestial purity (jingming) is proven in loyal duty and filial care; without ethical radiance in family and state roles, mystical “clarity” is counterfeit. The text argues that the Daoist path of Xu Xun’s lineage collapses the split between social virtue and immortal attainment.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Heaven’s light is moral order, not only luminous qi.
2) Premise: Human beings occupy relational offices (child, subject, friend) that either transmit or block that light.
3) Inference: Loyalty and filiality are therefore primary cultivation methods, not preliminaries.
4) Inference: Rectifying the heart in service purifies the spirit more reliably than secret techniques alone.
5) Conclusion: Immortality is the fruition of a life made transparent by zhong and xiao.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi counseling, treat broken family bonds and betrayed duty as primary “blockages” before chasing wealth gods.
2) Assign cultivation homework as concrete filial/loyal acts timed to relevant luck pillars.
3) Use Day Master ethics: strong authority stars → train just loyalty; weak resource → train care without depletion.
4) Replace guilt-magic with repair of concrete relationships as jingming practice.
5) Measure progress by decrease of resentment and increase of responsible clarity, not only meditation hours.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike neidan texts that interiorize all ethics into circulating light, Jingming makes social virtue the main furnace. Unlike Confucian pure ethics, it still frames loyalty/filiality as a Daoist immortal path. The distinctive proof: Heaven responds to pure public-private virtue as the true talisman."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "道法会元",
    "logic_thesis": "Daoist “methods” (fa) work only when lineage transmission, deity office, heart alignment, and technical protocol form one causal circuit. The anthology proves that raw power without authentic teaching and pure intent is either empty or demonic, while correct fa is applied cosmology.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: The cosmos is populated by lawful spirits and forces organized under higher Dao.
2) Premise: Humans may command or petition only by borrowing legitimate office and seals.
3) Inference: Lineage and registers (lu) confer temporary jurisdiction.
4) Inference: Techniques (mudra, spell, diagram, pace) are the language of that jurisdiction.
5) Inference: Heart-mind impurity breaks the circuit even if forms are correct.
6) Conclusion: Effective thunder rites and exorcism are moral-cosmic law enforcement, not private magic.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Never apply “method” against BaZi chart issues without ethical warrant and clear intent hygiene.
2) Map chart conflicts (clash, punishment) as disorder of qi-offices; remedy with order-restoring practice, not aggressive curse logic.
3) Study deity–trigram–direction correspondences as the same grid used in date selection and flying stars.
4) Prioritize transmission and precepts before collecting techniques.
5) Use ritual structure (purify–invite–state case–dispatch–close) as a template for any serious intention-work.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike single-lineage manuals, Dao Fa Hui Yuan is a comparative archive of methods that still converges on one logic: office + purity + protocol. Unlike pure philosophy, it is praxis-heavy. Its difference is encyclopedic proof that “fa” is systematic cosmology under discipline."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "三皇内文遗秘",
    "logic_thesis": "Primordial sovereignty of Heaven–Earth–Human is encoded in secret graphs and names that restore the practitioner to the Three Sovereigns’ ordering power. The text proves that archaic wen (patterns/texts) are not historical curiosities but operative keys that re-link microcosm to the original imperial-cosmic charter.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: The Three Sovereigns established the first lawful patterns of world-order.
2) Premise: Later disorder is loss of those patterns in mind and rite.
3) Inference: Recovering “inner texts” reinstalls primordial authority in the adept.
4) Inference: Secret names and forms act as compressed cosmograms affecting spirits and body.
5) Conclusion: Mastery of Sanhuang wen is return to source-governance of self and environment.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Treat BaZi as a personal “charter of offices”; cultivation aims to reclaim sovereign centrality of the Day Master as Human among Heaven–Earth.
2) Use archaic symbol meditation (trigrams, true names) carefully as concentration supports, never as vanity collection.
3) Practice body as three realms: head-Heaven, torso-Human, lower-Earth alignment in standing/sitting.
4) In disaster years, emphasize re-ordering daily pattern over chasing new talismans.
5) Study only with ethical boundaries: sovereignty without compassion becomes domination.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike Lingbao’s salvation bureaucracy, Sanhuang logic is archaic, pre-bureaucratic sovereignty through primordial patterns. Unlike later thunder rites’ martial command, it seeks restoration of original charter. Its uniqueness is archaeological power: oldest wen as living authority."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "洞玄灵宝五岳古本真形图",
    "logic_thesis": "Mountains are living talismanic bodies; their “true forms” are not maps of rock but spirit-topologies that protect, hide, and connect the adept to the five directional powers. The text proves that correctly held true-form diagrams grant passage, safety, and communion with mountain administrations.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Each sacred peak is a node of cosmic government and qi reservoir.
2) Premise: Spirits recognize and respond to true-form graphs as credentials.
3) Inference: Carrying or contemplating the graph aligns the person with that mountain’s jurisdiction.
4) Inference: Protection while traveling and access to numinous sites follow from recognition, not physical strength.
5) Conclusion: Geography becomes soteriological technology through true-form mediation.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Relate BaZi directional remedies (east Wood, south Fire, etc.) to Five Peaks as living directional courts, not abstract fengshui arrows.
2) For travel years or mobile luck, use mountain-true-form contemplation as mind-protection practice.
3) When chart shows weak root, “borrow” mountain stability via pilgrimage or visualization of corresponding peak.
4) Integrate five directions with five viscera in neidan orientation.
5) Prefer respectful entry into nature sites as ritual, not tourism.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike general fengshui form schools that read land shapes empirically, this text asserts revealed true forms as spirit credentials. Unlike pure interior alchemy, it keeps sacred geography external and authoritative. Difference: the mountain diagram is passport, not landscape sketch."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "清微仙谱",
    "logic_thesis": "Qingwei efficacy depends on a clear celestial genealogy: who transmits, who authorizes, and which pure-subtle (qingwei) source is invoked. The register proves that identity of lineage and pantheon is itself a logical condition of method—anonymous power is invalid.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Qingwei methods claim origin in the highest pure-subtle heavens.
2) Premise: Authority flows through named immortals and historical transmitters.
3) Inference: Correct invocation requires accurate knowledge of that chain.
4) Inference: Confusion of pantheon or false claim breaks the link to source.
5) Conclusion: The immortal register is not hagiography alone but a validation table for practice.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Before using any “Qingwei” or thunder method for chart remedies, verify lineage claim and precept requirements.
2) Treat ancestral lines in family BaZi similarly: unclear transmission → unclear support; clarify names and debts.
3) Use register reading as meditation on purity-subtlety: refine intention until it matches “qing–wei.”
4) Prefer fewer authentic practices over mixed pantheon stacking.
5) Record your own teachers and vows as a personal “living register.”",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike broad anthologies like Dao Fa Hui Yuan, Qingwei Xianpu focuses on identity and pedigree of a refined school. Unlike popular immortal stories, its function is juridical: who may act under which banner. Distinctive logic: genealogy as operational law."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "西升经",
    "logic_thesis": "Laozi’s western departure teaches that the Dao is realized by inward ascent and non-contention, not by clinging to empire, form, or even the teacher’s body. The scripture proves that “going west” is a philosophical vector: leave the gross for the subtle until spirit unifies with Dao.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Attachment to political and bodily form obscures the Dao.
2) Premise: The sage can transmit by word and then withdraw without residue of possession.
3) Inference: True study follows the movement from outer teaching to inner verification.
4) Inference: Emptiness, softness, and non-striving are the ascent path corresponding to “west/death of form.”
5) Conclusion: Liberation is rising by yielding—西升 as metaphysical direction, not mere travelogue.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi metal-west emphasis years, practice release of control and soft strength rather than forced breakthrough.
2) Use “teacher leaves” logic: techniques are rafts; do not idolize methods after insight.
3) Convert career/fame peaks into tests of non-attachment per Xisheng themes.
4) Daily: reduce one contention; observe qi settling as proof.
5) At dusk (west), review and empty the day’s grasping.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike narrative Laozi biographies that historicize the western gate exit, Xisheng Jing philosophizes departure as path structure. Unlike dense neidan metaphor, its language stays classical Daoist paradox. Difference: movement west = ascent by renunciation."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太上老君开天经",
    "logic_thesis": "Cosmos, culture, and salvation history unfold as successive openings enacted by Lord Lao through ages—chaos to form, form to teaching. The text proves that civilization’s arts and moral order are extensions of one continuous theogonic-cosmogonic activity of Dao-personified.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Before form, only undifferentiated Dao-potential.
2) Premise: Lord Lao appears in successive kalpas to open heavens and instruct rulers/sages.
3) Inference: Each cultural innovation (fire, writing, rites) is a further “opening” of order.
4) Inference: Human history is therefore nested inside Daoist salvation history.
5) Conclusion: To cultivate is to realign with the same opening-power that structured the world.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Read personal BaZi not as isolated fate but as a local “opening” within larger cycles—honor timing as cosmogonic rhythm.
2) When starting new ventures, ritualize “opening” (clear space, state intent, first pure act) mirroring kaitian logic.
3) Study ages of life as successive heavens: childhood, role, renunciation—each needs its teaching.
4) Use gratitude to civilizational arts as part of Daoist reverence, not secular leftover.
5) In meditation, reverse the sequence: from forms back toward pre-opening stillness.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike purely abstract cosmogonies (e.g., some Taiqing texts), this personifies process in Lord Lao’s serial manifestations. Unlike Buddhist kalpa narratives, it ties Chinese culture-heroes into Daoist revelation. Distinctive claim: history is ongoing divine opening."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "历世真仙体道通鉴",
    "logic_thesis": "Immortality is historically plural yet pattern-governed: diverse biographies converge on verified transformation of body-mind through Dao. The work proves by cumulative case record that “xian” is an attainable human trajectory, not a closed myth—while also showing many failed or partial paths.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: If only one story existed, it could be legend; many independent cases suggest a real domain of practice outcomes.
2) Premise: Biographies preserve methods, virtues, errors, and signs of attainment.
3) Inference: Comparing lives yields a typology of successful cultivation conditions.
4) Inference: Embodied verification (体道) is the criterion over mere reputation.
5) Conclusion: The tongjian functions as empirical theology of immortality across ages.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Use hagiographies as case studies parallel to BaZi life-readings: similar charts, different virtue → different end.
2) Extract recurring success factors (precepts, teacher, endurance, timing) into a personal checklist.
3) Avoid method-shopping by matching temperament (from chart) to historical models.
4) Note failure modes: greed for powers, impure intent, broken vows.
5) Keep a “living mirror”: journal your practice against patterns seen in the tongjian.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike single-immortal hagiography, it is comparative and archival. Unlike doctrinal treatises, argument proceeds by cases. Difference: proof of the path through a mirror of many lives (通鉴), not one revelation."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "犹龙传",
    "logic_thesis": "Laozi as “dragon-like” sage cannot be fixed as ordinary biography; his elusiveness itself demonstrates the Dao’s mode of appearing—visible in virtue and word, ungraspable as object. The text proves that true teaching authority is dragon-natured: transforming, withdrawing, exceeding linear history.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Confucius’s “dragon” metaphor marks a being beyond standard moral taxonomy.
2) Premise: Multiple appearances and transformations of Laozi across ages are recorded.
3) Inference: The sage’s identity is functional and cosmic, not merely human-historical.
4) Inference: Followers must learn the Dao’s motion (coil, soar, hide) rather than cling to one form of the teacher.
5) Conclusion: Hagiography becomes metaphysics: to know Laozi is to practice dragon-flexibility of spirit.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, strong unpredictable combinations (dragon-like chen dynamics, traveling stars) train adaptive virtue, not rigid plans.
2) Practice teaching and leading by example then withdrawing—avoid guru-fixation.
3) Cultivate soft power: influence without contention, per dragon-water imagery.
4) When luck changes, change form of practice without changing root vow.
5) Study Laozi episodes as models for timing: speak when heaven opens, hide when closed.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike Kaitian Jing’s cosmogonic serial openings, Youlong Zhuan emphasizes elusive personhood of the sage. Unlike dry chronicle, it uses mythic poly-appearance to make a philosophical point. Distinctive logic: biography as proof of uncatchable Dao."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "玉清金笥青华秘文金宝内炼丹诀",
    "logic_thesis": "Internal elixir is a precise psycho-physiological reversion: spirit governs qi, qi gathers as medicine, medicine births the golden treasure within—under strict moral and mental purity. Attributed to Zhang Boduan’s line of teaching, it proves that neidan success is lawful inner chemistry, not poetic metaphor alone.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Ordinary humans leak jing-qi-shen through emotion and desire.
2) Premise: The “medicine” is one’s own refined vitality reverse-circulated, not external stone.
3) Inference: Stillness and true intention (zhenyi) coagulate the scattered.
4) Inference: Fire timing (wen/wu) must match the arising of medicine or it burns or dissipates.
5) Inference: Moral leakage undoes technical gain.
6) Conclusion: The golden treasure is produced by governed reversion under Qinghua instruction.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Map BaZi resource/output/authority to jing-qi-shen management: know what you leak (output excess) and what you lack (resource weak).
2) Establish non-negotiable sleep, sexual moderation, and emotional hygiene as the “furnace wall.”
3) Practice sitting with true intention at the lower field before complex microcosmic orbit claims.
4) Use luck-cycle Fire/Water balance years to emphasize wen (gentle) vs wu (intense) practice accordingly.
5) Treat “金宝” as conserved attention and vitality measurable in daily life clarity.",
    "logic_compare": "Compared with the ultra-compressed Jin Dan Si Bai Zi, this text is more instructional and staged. Compared with purely moral Jingming, it is technical-interior. Difference: secret Qinghua pedagogy of step-wise inner refining with explicit medicine/fire logic."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "金丹四百字",
    "logic_thesis": "The entire neidan path can be reduced to a minimal axiom set: true lead and mercury, fire phases, embryo, and spiritualization—proving that complexity beyond essentials is often diagnostic of misunderstanding. Zhang Boduan’s four hundred characters argue by compression: if you grasp the hinge, verbosity is unnecessary.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Many alchemical terms refer to few real referents (spirit, qi, timing, repose).
2) Premise: Error multiplies when students chase synonyms as separate substances.
3) Inference: A short authentic formula outperforms long false elaboration.
4) Inference: Lead/mercury and fire/timing encode body-mind reversion law.
5) Conclusion: Mastery is verified by simplicity of principle and continuity of practice, not library size.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Distill your BaZi-based cultivation plan to 4–5 non-negotiables (sleep, breath, precept, sit, service).
2) When confused by jargon, translate every term back to jing-qi-shen and timing.
3) Use short formula recitation as mental seal before sitting.
4) Test teachers by whether they increase clarity or multiply mysteries.
5) In chart remedy, prefer one correct adjustment over stacked conflicting cures.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike expansive anthologies and long fu poems, this is aphoristic law. Unlike Wuzhen Pian’s richer poetry, Si Bai Zi is even more skeletal. Distinctive logic: truth proves itself by compressible essentials."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "还源篇",
    "logic_thesis": "All cultivation is homecoming: phenomena are waves; the source is one water. The text proves that practice succeeds when attention and vitality reverse from branching multiplicity to the unmarked origin—return (huan) is both method and goal.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Mind and qi disperse into the ten thousand affairs.
2) Premise: The source was never truly lost, only overlooked.
3) Inference: Each technique is valid only insofar as it returns the stream.
4) Inference: Recognizing the source ends frantic seeking that further disperses.
5) Conclusion: Immortality is stable abiding as source while functioning in the world.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi “outflow” years (heavy output/hurting officer), emphasize return practices: evening silence, breath-to-root, fewer projects.
2) Use a single daily “return cue” (bell, sunset, three breaths) as huan yuan drill.
3) When analyzing chart desire patterns, ask: does this choice return or further branch?
4) Meditate from senses → breath → lower field → open awareness as staged return.
5) Measure progress by speed of recovery after distraction, not by visions.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike fire-phase technical manuals, Huanyuan Pian foregrounds philosophical direction of the whole path. Unlike pure Chan-style suddenism, it still sits in neidan return language. Difference: teleology of source-return as the master key over apparatus."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "还丹复命篇",
    "logic_thesis": "Returning the elixir is restoring ming (life-mandate): destiny is not only astrological given but a vitality-order that can be repaired when yin-yang rejoin and the root is reclaimed. The text proves that neidan “return” has an explicit destiny-restorative function—复命 as ontological recovery.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Ming is damaged by reverse flow of desire and aging dissipation.
2) Premise: Dan is the recombined pure yang (or balanced yin-yang) recovered inside.
3) Inference: Successful return-dan re-stabilizes the mandate’s physiological base.
4) Inference: Therefore fate symptoms (weakness, chaos, shortened trajectory) can shift as ming is restored.
5) Conclusion: Alchemy is destiny-medicine: huan dan ↔ fu ming are one process.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Treat BaZi “weak ming” indicators (extreme imbalance, severe clashes in health palaces) as calls to vitality conservation first.
2) Align practice seasons with chart: replenish in resource seasons; refine in balanced seasons; protect in kill seasons.
3) Combine sitting with life-hygiene that literally restores mandate (circadian, breath, nutrition).
4) Re-read major luck pillars after sustained practice as “mandate revision,” not superstition of frozen fate.
5) Vow work: ethical purity prevents re-injury of ming after technical gain.",
    "logic_compare": "Closer to destiny language than purely mystical Huanyuan; more explicit than Si Bai Zi about 复命. Unlike Sanyuan juridical life-extension, it restores life via inner reconjunction. Distinctive hinge: elixir return = mandate restoration."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "翠虚篇",
    "logic_thesis": "Chen Nan’s teachings prove that sudden insight and gradual forging cooperate: the “green-void” mind opens, yet golden elixir still requires true teacher, true fire, and embodied verification. The collection argues against empty quietism and against blind technique by uniting Chan-like openness with Southern Lineage alchemy.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Without opening of mind, alchemy becomes tense material manipulation.
2) Premise: Without fire and medicine, “emptiness” becomes dead quiet.
3) Inference: True path alternates or unifies xu (void clarity) and shi (real refining).
4) Inference: Oral transmission corrects the student’s timing errors.
5) Conclusion: Cuixu’s corpus models integrated awakening-plus-forging as complete proof.",
    "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi types with strong intellect/Fire, emphasize embodied lower-field and humility to avoid clever-empty practice.
2) For heavy Earth/Water stagnation types, emphasize void-openness and release.
3) Structure sessions: open (quiet) → gather (medicine) → refine (fire) → rest (seal).
4) Seek feedback from lived signs (stability, compassion, health) not only experiences.
5) Study Chen Nan’s warnings as error-catalog in your journal.",
    "logic_compare": "Versus Zhang Boduan’s tighter classical formulas, Cuixu often shows more pedagogical variety and Chan inflection. Versus pure ritual salvation texts, it is adamantly interior. Difference: explicit synthesis of void mind and real elixir work under Southern Lineage flavor."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太上洞玄灵宝本行宿缘经",
    "logic_thesis": "Present spiritual capacity and obstacles are fruits of prior conduct (宿缘); therefore salvation requires acknowledging causal debt and renewing original Lingbao vows of universal aid. The text proves that “root practice” is inseparable from karmic history—you cannot skip causes by technique alone.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Beings arrive in unequal conditions because of past actions and vows.
2) Premise: Lingbao path is collective: self-benefit tied to benefit of all.
3) Inference: Reading and practicing now reactivates original pure vows and reweaves good yuan.
4) Inference: Confession and dedication redirect old hostile affinities.
5) Conclusion: Destiny softens when causal narrative is owned and rewritten through vow and practice.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Read difficult BaZi combinations as 宿缘 map: who you harm/help patterns, not random cruelty of heaven.
2) Pair technical remedies with vow renewal and concrete repair toward harmed parties or types.
3) Use anniversary/birthdays for “original practice” recollection and rededication.
4) In annual luck, prioritize resolving recurring relationship debts indicated by repeated clash patterns.
5) Dedicate practice merit to ancestors and adversaries to transform hostile yuan.",
    "logic_compare": "More karmic-narrative than pure ritual manuals; more vow-centered than neidan return texts. Unlike Confucian Jingming’s this-life ethics focus, it stresses multi-life affinities. Distinctive logic: original practice + predestined ties as the grammar of salvation."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太上洞玄灵宝诸天灵书度命妙经",
    "logic_thesis": "Life is delivered by true writs of the many heavens—sacred text itself is a ferry. The scripture proves that celestial “灵书” operate as luminous law: recitation and embodiment of the writ realign the person with higher registers that override death-bound trajectories.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Premise: Each heaven issues spiritual documents that order life and death.
2) Premise: Humans fall when cut off from those luminous ordinances.
3) Inference: The revealed lingshu reopens connection to multi-heaven protection.
4) Inference: Correct recitation is not noise but re-inscription of the fate body.
5) Conclusion: Degree-ming (度命) occurs when the adept’s mind-body becomes compliant text of the heavens.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Establish pure recitation periods (dawn/dusk) as fate-rewriting sessions, especially in health-threat or emptiness years.
2) Combine sound (recitation) with visualized light descending through the body as “document received.”
3) Keep precept purity so the “document” is not contradicted by conduct.
4) For BaZi weak Life palace, emphasize 度命 scriptures as complementary to medical care.

entries.name_han: 太上三元赐福赦罪解厄消灾延生保命妙经
entries.logic_thesis: Fortune, disaster, lifespan, and karmic debt are not fixed fate-blocks but administratively reversible under Heaven’s tripartite tribunal (Heaven–Earth–Water). The text proves that sincere repentance plus ritual alignment with the Three Officers can rewrite the ledger of destiny, making “extension of life” a juridical-moral process rather than mere petition.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: All beings are under continuous audit by the Three Officials who record merit and demerit.
2) Premise: Calamity and short life are effects of unresolved guilt recorded in those ledgers.
3) Inference: If the ledger is the cause, then pardon and merit-transfer can alter the effect.
4) Inference: Ritual confession, vow, and recitation are the lawful channels that petition and update the ledger.
5) Conclusion: Therefore disaster-relief and life-extension are achieved by moral-juridical correction under the Sanyuan system, not by coercion of the cosmos.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Map BaZi “illness/disaster stars” as ledger-symptoms: treat them as invitations to repent-and-correct, not as irreversible doom.
2) Use Three Officials timing (15th of 1st/7th/10th lunar months; or upper/middle/lower yuan cycles) to schedule confession, charity, and vow renewal.
3) Pair Day Master weakness or clash years with concrete merit acts (releasing life, debt repayment, apology) before purely technical remedies.
4) In cultivation, keep a nightly “merit–fault ledger” mirroring Sanyuan audit logic.
5) When reading “延生保命,” prioritize purifying intent and social harm-repair over amulet-only solutions.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure talismanic disaster-dispelling texts that treat power as external force, this scripture centers juridical pardon and moral accounting. Unlike pure internal-alchemy longevity texts, it locates life-extension in celestial bureaucracy and ethical correction. Its distinct logic is: destiny is a court record that can be amended.

entries.logic_thesis: True Quanzhen cultivation is not escape into technique but a graduated reorganization of life—dwelling, companions, study, work, sleep, and death—so that the Dao becomes the form of ordinary conduct. The text proves that without correct outer order (community, scripture, labor, stillness), inner alchemy collapses into self-deception.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: The mind scatters when environment, company, and daily rhythm are disordered.
2) Premise: Dao is realized through continuous practice, not isolated peak experiences.
3) Inference: Therefore lodging, travel, study, and work must be redesigned as supports of one-pointedness.
4) Inference: Scripture reading, seated meditation, and “matching natures” (hehe) train both insight and social virtue.
5) Inference: Detachment from wealth and fame removes the fuel of false seeking.
6) Conclusion: The fifteen essays form a single causal ladder: outer discipline → stable mind → genuine inner work → liberation at death.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Audit lifestyle before chart techniques: sleep, companions, speech, and livelihood as primary “stem–branch” of practice.
2) Use BaZi strong Fire/Wood restlessness as signal to emphasize sitting, quiet study, and limited travel per Chongyang’s rules.
3) Treat “matching natures” as partner/teacher selection criterion in cultivation communities.
4) Convert reading classics into daily short sessions rather than rare binge study.
5) At major luck-cycle transitions, re-apply the fifteen topics as a life-redesign checklist.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Southern Song technical neidan manuals that begin with medicine and fire phases, Chongyang starts from communal ethics and living arrangements. Unlike pure monastic codes, it still aims at interior realization. Its difference is pedagogical: form of life first, secret method second.

entries.logic_thesis: Salvation of the dead and living is an engineered liturgy: offices, documents, visualizations, and graded ranks transmit celestial authority into measurable deliverance. The work proves that “degree and ferrying” (jidù) is not vague compassion but a complete ritual technology of cosmic administration.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Souls suffer because they lack light, name-clearance, and pathway through the bureaucratic cosmos.
2) Premise: Lingbao liturgy inherits primordial writs that can reopen those pathways.
3) Inference: Correct rank, vestment, document, and mudra align the priest as a lawful officer of Heaven.
4) Inference: Sequential rites (purification, summoning, confession, transformation, rebirth) process the soul like a court case and medical cure combined.
5) Conclusion: Mass deliverance is possible when personal virtue + institutional rite + celestial text coincide.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Read ancestral hardship in BaZi (void, tomb, extreme Water/Metal grief) as possible unresolved lineage debt requiring jidù logic, not only personal luck-fix.
2) Before major destiny shifts, perform or sponsor structured requiem/confession rites rather than ad-hoc prayer.
3) Train visualization of light-body and document-sending as mind-stability practice even without full liturgy.
4) Use the text’s rank-and-office model to understand “authority” in talisman work: no office, no effect.
5) Align charity and public good works as the ethical warrant that makes ritual petitions valid.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with short Lingbao scriptures of praise and promise, this is an operational encyclopedia of how salvation is done. Compared with Quanzhen’s interior emphasis, it externalizes compassion into institutional rite. Its signature is liturgical engineering of universal deliverance.

entries.logic_thesis: Celestial purity (jingming) is proven in loyal duty and filial care; without ethical radiance in family and state roles, mystical “clarity” is counterfeit. The text argues that the Daoist path of Xu Xun’s lineage collapses the split between social virtue and immortal attainment.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Heaven’s light is moral order, not only luminous qi.
2) Premise: Human beings occupy relational offices (child, subject, friend) that either transmit or block that light.
3) Inference: Loyalty and filiality are therefore primary cultivation methods, not preliminaries.
4) Inference: Rectifying the heart in service purifies the spirit more reliably than secret techniques alone.
5) Conclusion: Immortality is the fruition of a life made transparent by zhong and xiao.
entries.logic_practice:
1) In BaZi counseling, treat broken family bonds and betrayed duty as primary “blockages” before chasing wealth gods.
2) Assign cultivation homework as concrete filial/loyal acts timed to relevant luck pillars.
3) Use Day Master ethics: strong authority stars → train just loyalty; weak resource → train care without depletion.
4) Replace guilt-magic with repair of concrete relationships as jingming practice.
5) Measure progress by decrease of resentment and increase of responsible clarity, not only meditation hours.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike neidan texts that interiorize all ethics into circulating light, Jingming makes social virtue the main furnace. Unlike Confucian pure ethics, it still frames loyalty/filiality as a Daoist immortal path. The distinctive proof: Heaven responds to pure public-private virtue as the true talisman.

entries.logic_thesis: Daoist “methods” (fa) work only when lineage transmission, deity office, heart alignment, and technical protocol form one causal circuit. The anthology proves that raw power without authentic teaching and pure intent is either empty or demonic, while correct fa is applied cosmology.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: The cosmos is populated by lawful spirits and forces organized under higher Dao.
2) Premise: Humans may command or petition only by borrowing legitimate office and seals.
3) Inference: Lineage and registers (lu) confer temporary jurisdiction.
4) Inference: Techniques (mudra, spell, diagram, pace) are the language of that jurisdiction.
5) Inference: Heart-mind impurity breaks the circuit even if forms are correct.
6) Conclusion: Effective thunder rites and exorcism are moral-cosmic law enforcement, not private magic.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Never apply “method” against BaZi chart issues without ethical warrant and clear intent hygiene.
2) Map chart conflicts (clash, punishment) as disorder of qi-offices; remedy with order-restoring practice, not aggressive curse logic.
3) Study deity–trigram–direction correspondences as the same grid used in date selection and flying stars.
4) Prioritize transmission and precepts before collecting techniques.
5) Use ritual structure (purify–invite–state case–dispatch–close) as a template for any serious intention-work.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-lineage manuals, Dao Fa Hui Yuan is a comparative archive of methods that still converges on one logic: office + purity + protocol. Unlike pure philosophy, it is praxis-heavy. Its difference is encyclopedic proof that “fa” is systematic cosmology under discipline.

entries.logic_thesis: Primordial sovereignty of Heaven–Earth–Human is encoded in secret graphs and names that restore the practitioner to the Three Sovereigns’ ordering power. The text proves that archaic wen (patterns/texts) are not historical curiosities but operative keys that re-link microcosm to the original imperial-cosmic charter.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: The Three Sovereigns established the first lawful patterns of world-order.
2) Premise: Later disorder is loss of those patterns in mind and rite.
3) Inference: Recovering “inner texts” reinstalls primordial authority in the adept.
4) Inference: Secret names and forms act as compressed cosmograms affecting spirits and body.
5) Conclusion: Mastery of Sanhuang wen is return to source-governance of self and environment.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Treat BaZi as a personal “charter of offices”; cultivation aims to reclaim sovereign centrality of the Day Master as Human among Heaven–Earth.
2) Use archaic symbol meditation (trigrams, true names) carefully as concentration supports, never as vanity collection.
3) Practice body as three realms: head-Heaven, torso-Human, lower-Earth alignment in standing/sitting.
4) In disaster years, emphasize re-ordering daily pattern over chasing new talismans.
5) Study only with ethical boundaries: sovereignty without compassion becomes domination.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Lingbao’s salvation bureaucracy, Sanhuang logic is archaic, pre-bureaucratic sovereignty through primordial patterns. Unlike later thunder rites’ martial command, it seeks restoration of original charter. Its uniqueness is archaeological power: oldest wen as living authority.

entries.name_han: 洞玄灵宝五岳古本真形图
entries.logic_thesis: Mountains are living talismanic bodies; their “true forms” are not maps of rock but spirit-topologies that protect, hide, and connect the adept to the five directional powers. The text proves that correctly held true-form diagrams grant passage, safety, and communion with mountain administrations.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Each sacred peak is a node of cosmic government and qi reservoir.
2) Premise: Spirits recognize and respond to true-form graphs as credentials.
3) Inference: Carrying or contemplating the graph aligns the person with that mountain’s jurisdiction.
4) Inference: Protection while traveling and access to numinous sites follow from recognition, not physical strength.
5) Conclusion: Geography becomes soteriological technology through true-form mediation.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Relate BaZi directional remedies (east Wood, south Fire, etc.) to Five Peaks as living directional courts, not abstract fengshui arrows.
2) For travel years or mobile luck, use mountain-true-form contemplation as mind-protection practice.
3) When chart shows weak root, “borrow” mountain stability via pilgrimage or visualization of corresponding peak.
4) Integrate five directions with five viscera in neidan orientation.
5) Prefer respectful entry into nature sites as ritual, not tourism.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike general fengshui form schools that read land shapes empirically, this text asserts revealed true forms as spirit credentials. Unlike pure interior alchemy, it keeps sacred geography external and authoritative. Difference: the mountain diagram is passport, not landscape sketch.

entries.logic_thesis: Qingwei efficacy depends on a clear celestial genealogy: who transmits, who authorizes, and which pure-subtle (qingwei) source is invoked. The register proves that identity of lineage and pantheon is itself a logical condition of method—anonymous power is invalid.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Qingwei methods claim origin in the highest pure-subtle heavens.
2) Premise: Authority flows through named immortals and historical transmitters.
3) Inference: Correct invocation requires accurate knowledge of that chain.
4) Inference: Confusion of pantheon or false claim breaks the link to source.
5) Conclusion: The immortal register is not hagiography alone but a validation table for practice.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Before using any “Qingwei” or thunder method for chart remedies, verify lineage claim and precept requirements.
2) Treat ancestral lines in family BaZi similarly: unclear transmission → unclear support; clarify names and debts.
3) Use register reading as meditation on purity-subtlety: refine intention until it matches “qing–wei.”
4) Prefer fewer authentic practices over mixed pantheon stacking.
5) Record your own teachers and vows as a personal “living register.”
entries.logic_compare: Unlike broad anthologies like Dao Fa Hui Yuan, Qingwei Xianpu focuses on identity and pedigree of a refined school. Unlike popular immortal stories, its function is juridical: who may act under which banner. Distinctive logic: genealogy as operational law.

entries.logic_thesis: Laozi’s western departure teaches that the Dao is realized by inward ascent and non-contention, not by clinging to empire, form, or even the teacher’s body. The scripture proves that “going west” is a philosophical vector: leave the gross for the subtle until spirit unifies with Dao.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Attachment to political and bodily form obscures the Dao.
2) Premise: The sage can transmit by word and then withdraw without residue of possession.
3) Inference: True study follows the movement from outer teaching to inner verification.
4) Inference: Emptiness, softness, and non-striving are the ascent path corresponding to “west/death of form.”
5) Conclusion: Liberation is rising by yielding—西升 as metaphysical direction, not mere travelogue.
entries.logic_practice:
1) In BaZi metal-west emphasis years, practice release of control and soft strength rather than forced breakthrough.
2) Use “teacher leaves” logic: techniques are rafts; do not idolize methods after insight.
3) Convert career/fame peaks into tests of non-attachment per Xisheng themes.
4) Daily: reduce one contention; observe qi settling as proof.
5) At dusk (west), review and empty the day’s grasping.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike narrative Laozi biographies that historicize the western gate exit, Xisheng Jing philosophizes departure as path structure. Unlike dense neidan metaphor, its language stays classical Daoist paradox. Difference: movement west = ascent by renunciation.

entries.logic_thesis: Cosmos, culture, and salvation history unfold as successive openings enacted by Lord Lao through ages—chaos to form, form to teaching. The text proves that civilization’s arts and moral order are extensions of one continuous theogonic-cosmogonic activity of Dao-personified.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Before form, only undifferentiated Dao-potential.
2) Premise: Lord Lao appears in successive kalpas to open heavens and instruct rulers/sages.
3) Inference: Each cultural innovation (fire, writing, rites) is a further “opening” of order.
4) Inference: Human history is therefore nested inside Daoist salvation history.
5) Conclusion: To cultivate is to realign with the same opening-power that structured the world.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Read personal BaZi not as isolated fate but as a local “opening” within larger cycles—honor timing as cosmogonic rhythm.
2) When starting new ventures, ritualize “opening” (clear space, state intent, first pure act) mirroring kaitian logic.
3) Study ages of life as successive heavens: childhood, role, renunciation—each needs its teaching.
4) Use gratitude to civilizational arts as part of Daoist reverence, not secular leftover.
5) In meditation, reverse the sequence: from forms back toward pre-opening stillness.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely abstract cosmogonies (e.g., some Taiqing texts), this personifies process in Lord Lao’s serial manifestations. Unlike Buddhist kalpa narratives, it ties Chinese culture-heroes into Daoist revelation. Distinctive claim: history is ongoing divine opening.

entries.logic_thesis: Immortality is historically plural yet pattern-governed: diverse biographies converge on verified transformation of body-mind through Dao. The work proves by cumulative case record that “xian” is an attainable human trajectory, not a closed myth—while also showing many failed or partial paths.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: If only one story existed, it could be legend; many independent cases suggest a real domain of practice outcomes.
2) Premise: Biographies preserve methods, virtues, errors, and signs of attainment.
3) Inference: Comparing lives yields a typology of successful cultivation conditions.
4) Inference: Embodied verification (体道) is the criterion over mere reputation.
5) Conclusion: The tongjian functions as empirical theology of immortality across ages.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Use hagiographies as case studies parallel to BaZi life-readings: similar charts, different virtue → different end.
2) Extract recurring success factors (precepts, teacher, endurance, timing) into a personal checklist.
3) Avoid method-shopping by matching temperament (from chart) to historical models.
4) Note failure modes: greed for powers, impure intent, broken vows.
5) Keep a “living mirror”: journal your practice against patterns seen in the tongjian.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-immortal hagiography, it is comparative and archival. Unlike doctrinal treatises, argument proceeds by cases. Difference: proof of the path through a mirror of many lives (通鉴), not one revelation.

entries.logic_thesis: Laozi as “dragon-like” sage cannot be fixed as ordinary biography; his elusiveness itself demonstrates the Dao’s mode of appearing—visible in virtue and word, ungraspable as object. The text proves that true teaching authority is dragon-natured: transforming, withdrawing, exceeding linear history.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Confucius’s “dragon” metaphor marks a being beyond standard moral taxonomy.
2) Premise: Multiple appearances and transformations of Laozi across ages are recorded.
3) Inference: The sage’s identity is functional and cosmic, not merely human-historical.
4) Inference: Followers must learn the Dao’s motion (coil, soar, hide) rather than cling to one form of the teacher.
5) Conclusion: Hagiography becomes metaphysics: to know Laozi is to practice dragon-flexibility of spirit.
entries.logic_practice:
1) In BaZi, strong unpredictable combinations (dragon-like chen dynamics, traveling stars) train adaptive virtue, not rigid plans.
2) Practice teaching and leading by example then withdrawing—avoid guru-fixation.
3) Cultivate soft power: influence without contention, per dragon-water imagery.
4) When luck changes, change form of practice without changing root vow.
5) Study Laozi episodes as models for timing: speak when heaven opens, hide when closed.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Kaitian Jing’s cosmogonic serial openings, Youlong Zhuan emphasizes elusive personhood of the sage. Unlike dry chronicle, it uses mythic poly-appearance to make a philosophical point. Distinctive logic: biography as proof of uncatchable Dao.

entries.name_han: 玉清金笥青华秘文金宝内炼丹诀
entries.logic_thesis: Internal elixir is a precise psycho-physiological reversion: spirit governs qi, qi gathers as medicine, medicine births the golden treasure within—under strict moral and mental purity. Attributed to Zhang Boduan’s line of teaching, it proves that neidan success is lawful inner chemistry, not poetic metaphor alone.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Ordinary humans leak jing-qi-shen through emotion and desire.
2) Premise: The “medicine” is one’s own refined vitality reverse-circulated, not external stone.
3) Inference: Stillness and true intention (zhenyi) coagulate the scattered.
4) Inference: Fire timing (wen/wu) must match the arising of medicine or it burns or dissipates.
5) Inference: Moral leakage undoes technical gain.
6) Conclusion: The golden treasure is produced by governed reversion under Qinghua instruction.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Map BaZi resource/output/authority to jing-qi-shen management: know what you leak (output excess) and what you lack (resource weak).
2) Establish non-negotiable sleep, sexual moderation, and emotional hygiene as the “furnace wall.”
3) Practice sitting with true intention at the lower field before complex microcosmic orbit claims.
4) Use luck-cycle Fire/Water balance years to emphasize wen (gentle) vs wu (intense) practice accordingly.
5) Treat “金宝” as conserved attention and vitality measurable in daily life clarity.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with the ultra-compressed Jin Dan Si Bai Zi, this text is more instructional and staged. Compared with purely moral Jingming, it is technical-interior. Difference: secret Qinghua pedagogy of step-wise inner refining with explicit medicine/fire logic.

entries.logic_thesis: The entire neidan path can be reduced to a minimal axiom set: true lead and mercury, fire phases, embryo, and spiritualization—proving that complexity beyond essentials is often diagnostic of misunderstanding. Zhang Boduan’s four hundred characters argue by compression: if you grasp the hinge, verbosity is unnecessary.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Many alchemical terms refer to few real referents (spirit, qi, timing, repose).
2) Premise: Error multiplies when students chase synonyms as separate substances.
3) Inference: A short authentic formula outperforms long false elaboration.
4) Inference: Lead/mercury and fire/timing encode body-mind reversion law.
5) Conclusion: Mastery is verified by simplicity of principle and continuity of practice, not library size.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Distill your BaZi-based cultivation plan to 4–5 non-negotiables (sleep, breath, precept, sit, service).
2) When confused by jargon, translate every term back to jing-qi-shen and timing.
3) Use short formula recitation as mental seal before sitting.
4) Test teachers by whether they increase clarity or multiply mysteries.
5) In chart remedy, prefer one correct adjustment over stacked conflicting cures.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike expansive anthologies and long fu poems, this is aphoristic law. Unlike Wuzhen Pian’s richer poetry, Si Bai Zi is even more skeletal. Distinctive logic: truth proves itself by compressible essentials.

entries.logic_thesis: All cultivation is homecoming: phenomena are waves; the source is one water. The text proves that practice succeeds when attention and vitality reverse from branching multiplicity to the unmarked origin—return (huan) is both method and goal.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Mind and qi disperse into the ten thousand affairs.
2) Premise: The source was never truly lost, only overlooked.
3) Inference: Each technique is valid only insofar as it returns the stream.
4) Inference: Recognizing the source ends frantic seeking that further disperses.
5) Conclusion: Immortality is stable abiding as source while functioning in the world.
entries.logic_practice:
1) In BaZi “outflow” years (heavy output/hurting officer), emphasize return practices: evening silence, breath-to-root, fewer projects.
2) Use a single daily “return cue” (bell, sunset, three breaths) as huan yuan drill.
3) When analyzing chart desire patterns, ask: does this choice return or further branch?
4) Meditate from senses → breath → lower field → open awareness as staged return.
5) Measure progress by speed of recovery after distraction, not by visions.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike fire-phase technical manuals, Huanyuan Pian foregrounds philosophical direction of the whole path. Unlike pure Chan-style suddenism, it still sits in neidan return language. Difference: teleology of source-return as the master key over apparatus.

entries.logic_thesis: Returning the elixir is restoring ming (life-mandate): destiny is not only astrological given but a vitality-order that can be repaired when yin-yang rejoin and the root is reclaimed. The text proves that neidan “return” has an explicit destiny-restorative function—复命 as ontological recovery.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Ming is damaged by reverse flow of desire and aging dissipation.
2) Premise: Dan is the recombined pure yang (or balanced yin-yang) recovered inside.
3) Inference: Successful return-dan re-stabilizes the mandate’s physiological base.
4) Inference: Therefore fate symptoms (weakness, chaos, shortened trajectory) can shift as ming is restored.
5) Conclusion: Alchemy is destiny-medicine: huan dan ↔ fu ming are one process.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Treat BaZi “weak ming” indicators (extreme imbalance, severe clashes in health palaces) as calls to vitality conservation first.
2) Align practice seasons with chart: replenish in resource seasons; refine in balanced seasons; protect in kill seasons.
3) Combine sitting with life-hygiene that literally restores mandate (circadian, breath, nutrition).
4) Re-read major luck pillars after sustained practice as “mandate revision,” not superstition of frozen fate.
5) Vow work: ethical purity prevents re-injury of ming after technical gain.
entries.logic_compare: Closer to destiny language than purely mystical Huanyuan; more explicit than Si Bai Zi about 复命. Unlike Sanyuan juridical life-extension, it restores life via inner reconjunction. Distinctive hinge: elixir return = mandate restoration.

entries.logic_thesis: Chen Nan’s teachings prove that sudden insight and gradual forging cooperate: the “green-void” mind opens, yet golden elixir still requires true teacher, true fire, and embodied verification. The collection argues against empty quietism and against blind technique by uniting Chan-like openness with Southern Lineage alchemy.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Without opening of mind, alchemy becomes tense material manipulation.
2) Premise: Without fire and medicine, “emptiness” becomes dead quiet.
3) Inference: True path alternates or unifies xu (void clarity) and shi (real refining).
4) Inference: Oral transmission corrects the student’s timing errors.
5) Conclusion: Cuixu’s corpus models integrated awakening-plus-forging as complete proof.
entries.logic_practice:
1) For BaZi types with strong intellect/Fire, emphasize embodied lower-field and humility to avoid clever-empty practice.
2) For heavy Earth/Water stagnation types, emphasize void-openness and release.
3) Structure sessions: open (quiet) → gather (medicine) → refine (fire) → rest (seal).
4) Seek feedback from lived signs (stability, compassion, health) not only experiences.
5) Study Chen Nan’s warnings as error-catalog in your journal.
entries.logic_compare: Versus Zhang Boduan’s tighter classical formulas, Cuixu often shows more pedagogical variety and Chan inflection. Versus pure ritual salvation texts, it is adamantly interior. Difference: explicit synthesis of void mind and real elixir work under Southern Lineage flavor.

entries.name_han: 太上洞玄灵宝本行宿缘经
entries.logic_thesis: Present spiritual capacity and obstacles are fruits of prior conduct (宿缘); therefore salvation requires acknowledging causal debt and renewing original Lingbao vows of universal aid. The text proves that “root practice” is inseparable from karmic history—you cannot skip causes by technique alone.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Beings arrive in unequal conditions because of past actions and vows.
2) Premise: Lingbao path is collective: self-benefit tied to benefit of all.
3) Inference: Reading and practicing now reactivates original pure vows and reweaves good yuan.
4) Inference: Confession and dedication redirect old hostile affinities.
5) Conclusion: Destiny softens when causal narrative is owned and rewritten through vow and practice.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Read difficult BaZi combinations as 宿缘 map: who you harm/help patterns, not random cruelty of heaven.
2) Pair technical remedies with vow renewal and concrete repair toward harmed parties or types.
3) Use anniversary/birthdays for “original practice” recollection and rededication.
4) In annual luck, prioritize resolving recurring relationship debts indicated by repeated clash patterns.
5) Dedicate practice merit to ancestors and adversaries to transform hostile yuan.
entries.logic_compare: More karmic-narrative than pure ritual manuals; more vow-centered than neidan return texts. Unlike Confucian Jingming’s this-life ethics focus, it stresses multi-life affinities. Distinctive logic: original practice + predestined ties as the grammar of salvation.

entries.name_han: 太上洞玄灵宝诸天灵书度命妙经
entries.logic_thesis: Life is delivered by true writs of the many heavens—sacred text itself is a ferry. The scripture proves that celestial “灵书” operate as luminous law: recitation and embodiment of the writ realign the person with higher registers that override death-bound trajectories.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: Each heaven issues spiritual documents that order life and death.
2) Premise: Humans fall when cut off from those luminous ordinances.
3) Inference: The revealed lingshu reopens connection to multi-heaven protection.
4) Inference: Correct recitation is not noise but re-inscription of the fate body.
5) Conclusion: Degree-ming (度命) occurs when the adept’s mind-body becomes compliant text of the heavens.
entries.logic_practice:
1) Establish pure recitation periods (dawn/dusk) as fate-rewriting sessions, especially in health-threat or emptiness years.
2) Combine sound (recitation) with visualized light descending through the body as “document received.”
3) Keep precept purity so the “document” is not contradicted by conduct.
4) For BaZi weak Life palace, emphasize 度命 scriptures as complementary to medical care.
5) Copy or carefully write sacred lines as kinetic meditation—writing as inscription of ming.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike Sanyuan’s juridical confession focus, this emphasizes multi-heaven writs as direct luminous agents. Unlike neidan’s wordless medicine, it grants text itself soteriological power. Difference: scripture as living passport across heavens for delivering life.

entries.name_han: 元始无量度人上品妙经四注
entries.logic_thesis: The Duren Jing’s four commentaries prove that one primordial revelation supports multiple valid interpretive layers—cosmological, liturgical, ethical, and interior—while remaining one salvation program of Yuanshi. The collective exegesis demonstrates that infinite deliverance is intelligible only when commentarial reason unpacks the compressed celestial hymn.
entries.logic_chain:
1) Premise: The root scripture is numinous, terse, and polyvalent.
2) Premise: Without interpretation, practitioners grasp sound but miss structure.
3) Inference: Four notes supply complementary maps (heavens, rites, body-gods, moral cosmos).
4) Inference: Cross-reading prevents reducing 度人 to either empty chant or private mysticism alone.
5) Conclusion: Scholarly-ritual exegesis is part of the salvation technology: understanding multiplies efficacy of practice.
entries.logic_practice:
1) When using Duren recitation for BaZi disaster cycles, study at least one commentary layer so intent matches content.
2) Map “heavens and lands” in the text onto body regions and chart palaces as interior 度人.
3) Alternate: day of pure recitation / day of commentarial study to unite faith and reason.
4) Apply 度人 ethically: deliver others (charity, teaching, rite) as proof the text is working.
5) In group practice, assign roles—reciter, meaning-holder, dedicating dedicant—mirroring commentarial plurality.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-author neidan poems, this is layered scholastic-ritual tradition around one core revelation. Unlike raw scripture-only piety, the four notes insist that interpretation is necessary for full 度人. Distinctive logic: infinite salvation requires plural reasoned exegesis of one Primordial text.
